definitions.gloss: attendance; presence at a formal event
definitions.explanation: Being present at a formal ceremony, meeting, or occasion. More formal than simply attending.

examples.japanese: {式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{列席|れっせき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{列席|れっせき}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{方々|かたがた}→方々：02778_katagata⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{礼|れい}→お礼：01359_orei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{述|の}べた→述べる：02389_noberu⟧。
examples.english: I expressed thanks to those who attended the wedding.

examples.japanese: ⟦{各国|かっこく}→各国：12055_kakkoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{列席|れっせき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧、⟦{首脳|しゅのう}→首脳：15631_shunou⟧⟦{会談|かいだん}→会談：11542_kaidan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The summit was held in the presence of representatives from each country.

notes:
USAGE:
{列席|れっせき} is a formal word for attending an event. It is used for ceremonies, official functions, and formal gatherings — not for casual meetings or classes.

FORMS:
⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧ (row, line) + ⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (seat) — to take one's seat in the assembly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {式|しき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{列席|れっせき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to attend a ceremony
- {列席者|れっせきしゃ}: those in attendance
- ご{列席|れっせき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{皆様|みなさま}→皆様：15860_minasama⟧: esteemed guests in attendance

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{出席|しゅっせき}→出席：02084_shusseki⟧ is the general word for attendance (classes, meetings). {列席|れっせき} is reserved for formal ceremonies and official occasions.
